title: County functions.
bodyText: Each county may establish a county office on aging and a county council on aging pursuant to the Older Americans Act of 1965, as amended.
bodyHtml: §349-9  County functions.  Each county may establish a county office on aging and a county council on aging pursuant to the Older Americans Act of 1965, as amended. [L 1976, c 217, pt of §2; am L 1979, c 136, §1(2)]
